title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v48
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds benchmark-lab profiling baselines, new representative workload runners for mixed CPU/GPU and long-context models, and an updated reporting pipeline (v48). No breaking changes. Includes dashboards and alerts for regression detection.
description: Motivation: As we onboard wider model families and more realistic production traffic patterns we need stable profiling baselines and representative workload runners to detect regressions in latency and token-cost. This PR adds profiling baselines, a set of representative workload runners for mixed CPU/GPU and long-sequence workloads, and a reporting pipeline (v48) that aggregates results into the benchmark lab reporting store and Grafana dashboards. Summary of changes: 1) profiling/baselines/: new canonical baseline configs for cold-start, warm-cache, and KV-heavy workloads; 2) runners/representative/: three new runners (mixed-gpu-cpu, long-context-gpt, streaming-chat) with workload manifests and harnesses; 3) reporting/pipeline/v48/: updated ingestion job that normalizes new metrics (p50/p90/p99 tail, bundle token-cost, memory high-water) and writes to the reporting store; 4) dashboards/: Grafana dashboard + alert rules for regression detection; 5) CI: new benchmark-run job and flaky test fixes. Checklist: - [x] Add baseline configs and manifests - [x] Implement runners and local docker dev images - [x] Integrate reporting ingestion and normalization - [x] Add dashboards and alerts - [x] End-to-end CI coverage and smoke tests - [x] Docs/README for running locally Testing and validation: Local runs with the new runners against a small sample of models (gpt-small-open, redwood-1.1) were executed; profiling baselines were recorded and compared to previous baseline v47. The reporting pipeline was tested end-to-end in staging (job runner + normalization + store write) and dashboards verified. Backwards compatibility: All runner manifests are additive; existing benchmark jobs continue to run unmodified. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy reporting pipeline to staging for 48 hours, run automated regression checks against baseline v48, then promote to production if no regressions. Notes: The reporting pipeline introduces a new metric field "bundle_token_cost"; consumers should tolerate missing fields when reading older reports. See linked Linear items for follow-up work on alert tuning.
